newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Aneka Kimia to set up joint ventures.
newsitem.headline: Aneka Kimia to set up joint ventures.

text.p: Indonesian chemical firm PT Aneka Kimia Raya is negotiating with several foreign companies to set up joint ventures to manufacture chemical products, an Aneka official said on Thursday.

"We are holding serious negotiations. We expect to finalise one deal by the end of 1996. We expect to disclose (announce) another two or three joint-ventures next year," Aneka's financial director Sutirta Budiman told Reuters.
He said the company has forecast flat growth in its 1997 net profit, but did not give the reasons.
Budiman said that the company was forecast to post a net profit of 27 billion rupiah this year.
Aneka Kimia was actively traded on Thursday on speculative buying, brokers said.
"There's no clear reason, it just rose sharply. Most the buyers are local investors," a local broker said.
Aneka Kimia rose 250 rupiah, or 22.22 percent, to 1,375 in late trade on Thursday after reaching 1,400 rupiah earlier on a volume of 3.1 million shares.
